description: Machine-readable bridge contract mapping the historical Qt/QWebChannel frontend bridge to the Electron/Python JSONL sidecar for LecturePack Phase 8. The contract and test oracle are reconciled with the four narrow production-seam operations implemented for the Phase 8 gate.

operations.name: acknowledge_setup
operations.notes: First-run setup acknowledgement is deferred.

operations.name: active_job
operations.notes: Names which lecture the workspace belongs to.

operations.name: ai_done
operations.notes: Signals the Ask AI stream completed.

operations.name: ai_status
operations.notes: Reports the active AI provider label and model.

operations.name: ai_token
operations.notes: Streams accumulated answer text from Ask AI.

operations.name: ask_ai
operations.notes: Streams an answer via ai_token then ai_done; built-in extractive fallback when no local model.

operations.name: bootstrap_complete
operations.notes: Emitted by the sidecar after engine and packaged-runtime bootstrap completes; the payload closes the existing runtime gate for the production CPU bundle.

operations.name: bootstrap_progress
operations.notes: Emitted by the sidecar while the engine imports.

operations.name: browse_model
operations.notes: Electron main opens a model file dialog and forwards the selection; emits settings_changed.

operations.name: browse_video
operations.notes: Electron main opens a dialog and forwards the selection to import_video.

operations.name: cancel_cuda_pack
operations.notes: Cancels an in-flight CUDA-pack download.

operations.name: cancel_flashcards
operations.notes: Cancels an in-flight flashcard generation; emits flashcards_status cancelled.

operations.name: cancel_job
operations.notes: Cancels the active pipeline and reports the terminal status.

operations.name: cancel_media_url
operations.notes: Cancels an in-flight link download and cleans partial files.

operations.name: cancel_quiz
operations.notes: Cancels an in-flight quiz generation; emits quiz_status cancelled.

operations.name: cancel_smart_study
operations.notes: Cancels an in-flight Smart Study setup.

operations.name: cancel_update_download
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: check_updates
operations.notes: Updater is deferred; not required by Phase 8.

operations.name: clear_skipped_version
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: cuda_pack
operations.notes: CUDA-pack install progress/state events.

operations.name: cuda_pack_status
operations.notes: Emits CUDA-pack install/availability state via cuda_pack.

operations.name: cuda_status
operations.notes: CUDA (NVIDIA GPU) backend availability and selection report.

operations.name: delete_job
operations.notes: Deletes one job safely (recycle-bin first); emits job_deleted and refreshes jobs_changed.

operations.name: delete_jobs
operations.notes: Bulk delete from Home multi-select; one job_deleted summary and one jobs_changed refresh.

operations.name: demo_event
operations.notes: Guided demo events are deferred.

operations.name: diagnostics
operations.notes: Carries a redacted diagnostics bundle or runtime-fallback notice.

operations.name: end_demo_job
operations.notes: The guided demo end maps to cancel_job but is out of the Phase 8 core.

operations.name: enqueue_job
operations.notes: Adds a job to the FIFO processing queue; emits queue_changed and jobs_changed.

operations.name: error
operations.notes: Sent for command failures and stage failures; carries ok:false on command responses.

operations.name: exit
operations.notes: Emitted by the Electron host when the sidecar exits.

operations.name: exit_application
operations.notes: app.js exit_application is not a real backend slot; the renderer closes the window and the host performs clean shutdown via the shutdown command.

operations.name: export
operations.notes: app.js export_all and export_one both map to the export command.

operations.name: export_all
operations.notes: app.js export_all maps to the export sidecar command.

operations.name: export_done
operations.notes: Signals the Study Pack export completed.

operations.name: export_one
operations.notes: app.js export_one maps to the export sidecar command.

operations.name: export_progress
operations.notes: Emitted during the Export stage with the existing UI fields pct and label.

operations.name: flashcards_changed
operations.notes: Carries the generated flashcards and their provider metadata.

operations.name: flashcards_status
operations.notes: Reports flashcard generation state (generating/ready/error/cancelled).

operations.name: generate_flashcards
operations.notes: Generates flashcards (AI or fallback); emits flashcards_changed/status.

operations.name: generate_quiz
operations.notes: Generates a quiz (AI or deterministic fallback); emits quiz_changed/quiz_status.

operations.name: get_bootstrap
operations.notes: app.js requests initial state via get_bootstrap; Electron intercepts as a noop and drives bootstrap via ready + host bootstrap.

operations.name: get_job
operations.notes: Restores one persisted job; the Electron host calls get_job + get_slides + get_transcript on reopen.

operations.name: get_notification_prefs
operations.notes: Emits notification_prefs with the persisted toggles.

operations.name: get_post_completion
operations.notes: Post-completion coaching is deferred.

operations.name: get_slides
operations.notes: Reads detected slide candidates and emits slides_changed.

operations.name: get_transcript
operations.notes: Reads the canonical transcript and emits transcript_changed.

operations.name: get_updater_state
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: groq_status
operations.notes: Groq credential state; never contains the key itself.

operations.name: health_check
operations.notes: Sidecar verifies the engine and packaged CPU runtime before the Electron host bootstraps the job list.

operations.name: import_media_url
operations.notes: Downloads a link then hands the file to the normal import path; emits media_progress/media_done.

operations.name: import_video
operations.notes: Creates a persisted job from a local file and activates it.

operations.name: install_cuda_pack
operations.notes: Downloads + verifies + installs the optional CUDA acceleration pack; emits cuda_pack progress. Requires explicit frontend command.

operations.name: install_downloaded_update
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: install_smart_study
operations.notes: One-action Smart Study setup: ensure the preset's model, test it, persist; emits smart_study progress.

operations.name: install_update
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: job_completed
operations.notes: Emitted after the final Export stage completes.

operations.name: job_deleted
operations.notes: Reports a single or bulk delete result; the UI refreshes from jobs_changed.

operations.name: jobs_changed
operations.notes: Renderer-facing signal is the direct job-summary array expected by app.ui.app.js; electron-bridge.js strips the envelope.

operations.name: launch_ollama_installer
operations.notes: Opens the official Ollama download page; never downloads/executes the installer itself.

operations.name: list_jobs
operations.notes: Enumerates persisted jobs and emits a jobs_changed summary array.

operations.name: list_ollama_models
operations.notes: Fetches installed Ollama models (/api/tags) and emits ollama_models.

operations.name: log_line
operations.notes: Streams processing log lines to the renderer.

operations.name: log_tour_trace
operations.notes: Onboarding tour tracing is deferred.

operations.name: media_done
operations.notes: Terminal outcome of a link download; ok:true hands off to import_video.

operations.name: media_link_state
operations.notes: Capability report for the Paste Link entry point.

operations.name: media_link_support
operations.notes: Reports whether link import is available in this build; also emits media_link_state.

operations.name: media_probe
operations.notes: Probe result for a pasted link (title/duration/uploader).

operations.name: media_progress
operations.notes: Coalesced download progress for a link import.

operations.name: notification_navigate
operations.notes: Notification events are deferred.

operations.name: notification_prefs
operations.notes: Persisted notification preference toggles.

operations.name: ollama_models
operations.notes: Installed Ollama models for the Settings model picker.

operations.name: onboarding
operations.notes: Carries the newly imported video summary for the home screen.

operations.name: open_export_folder
operations.notes: Handled in the Electron main process via get_job.response.export_dir.

operations.name: open_job
operations.notes: app.js open_job maps to the get_job sidecar command.

operations.name: open_job_folder
operations.notes: Handled in the Electron main process via get_job.response.job_dir.

operations.name: open_release_page
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: pause_job
operations.notes: Cooperatively pauses the active job; emits pause_state and jobs_changed.

operations.name: pause_state
operations.notes: Reports the cooperative pause state of the active job.

operations.name: pipeline_changed
operations.notes: Carries the per-stage progress array consumed by the pipeline/stages UI.

operations.name: post_completion
operations.notes: Post-completion events are deferred.

operations.name: probe_media_url
operations.notes: Resolves a link's metadata without downloading; also emits media_probe.

operations.name: queue_changed
operations.notes: Carries the queue rows, active slot, and schedules after any queue mutation.

operations.name: quiz_changed
operations.notes: Carries the generated quiz and its provider metadata.

operations.name: quiz_status
operations.notes: Reports quiz generation state (generating/ready/error/cancelled).

operations.name: ready
operations.notes: Sent once by the sidecar when the engine and stdin reader are ready.

operations.name: remove_from_queue
operations.notes: Removes a job from the queue/schedule; emits queue_changed and jobs_changed.

operations.name: remove_groq_key
operations.notes: Removes the stored Groq API key; emits groq_status.

operations.name: reorder_queue
operations.notes: Moves a queued job to a new position; emits queue_changed.

operations.name: repair_event
operations.notes: Runtime repair lifecycle events (metadata_ready/failed/cancelled/admitted).

operations.name: repair_selection
operations.notes: Runs the engine's context-repair on the selected transcript segments.

operations.name: restart_job
operations.notes: Restarts an interrupted job from the beginning; emits jobs_changed.

operations.name: resume_job
operations.notes: Resumes a paused/interrupted job from its checkpoint; emits jobs_changed.

operations.name: retry_stage
operations.notes: Retries a single failed stage, preserving completed upstream work.

operations.name: run_diagnostics
operations.notes: Emits a redacted diagnostics bundle for a job via the diagnostics event.

operations.name: run_now
operations.notes: Jumps a queued job to the front of the queue; emits queue_changed.

operations.name: save_corrections
operations.notes: Persists the existing transcript working layer and legacy edited.json mirror without changing raw transcript output.

operations.name: save_flashcard_session
operations.notes: Persists flashcard session state (known/unsure/index) in study data.

operations.name: save_notes
operations.notes: Persists the user's free-text notes for the current job.

operations.name: save_project
operations.notes: Project save is deferred.

operations.name: save_quiz_session
operations.notes: Persists quiz session state (answers/score/index) in study data.

operations.name: schedule_job
operations.notes: Schedules a job for a future time; emits queue_changed and jobs_changed.

operations.name: set_auto_check
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: set_groq_key
operations.notes: Stores the Groq API key in the OS credential manager; emits groq_status. Key never logged.

operations.name: set_job_group
operations.notes: Sets/clears a job's course/subject group (persisted in its manifest); refreshes jobs_changed.

operations.name: set_jobs_group
operations.notes: Groups several jobs at once; one jobs_changed refresh for the batch.

operations.name: set_notification_prefs
operations.notes: Persists notification toggles; emits notification_prefs.

operations.name: set_setting
operations.notes: Primary processing settings applied; secondary acknowledged without persistence; theme handled locally and never sent to the sidecar.

operations.name: set_slide_state
operations.notes: Persists the existing candidates.json accept/reject decision by the renderer slide index and refreshes slides_changed.

operations.name: set_study_preset
operations.notes: Persists the chosen Smart Study preset + its model; emits settings_changed.

operations.name: set_update_channel
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: settings_changed
operations.notes: Emitted after a set_setting call; carries the applied key/value.

operations.name: shutdown
operations.notes: Stops the sidecar; the Electron host then terminates the full process tree and emits exit.

operations.name: skip_update_version
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: slides_changed
operations.notes: Carries the slide list and duration for the slides screen.

operations.name: smart_study
operations.notes: Full Smart Study snapshot: presets, RAM recommendation, provider, Ollama availability.

operations.name: smart_study_status
operations.notes: Probes Ollama + installed models and emits a full smart_study snapshot.

operations.name: start_demo_job
operations.notes: The guided demo maps to start_job but is out of the Phase 8 core; production scope hides the demo entry point.

operations.name: start_processing
operations.notes: app.js start_processing maps to the start_job command with mode, preset, and auto_export.

operations.name: start_update_download
operations.notes: Updater is deferred.

operations.name: status_changed
operations.notes: Reports the job status label and percent.

operations.name: storage_changed
operations.notes: Disk usage of the data dir; the sidebar storage widget stays hidden until this arrives.

operations.name: study_changed
operations.notes: Carries the Study workspace overview payload.

operations.name: test_endpoint
operations.notes: Pings the local AI endpoint; emits ai_status.

operations.name: test_groq_key
operations.notes: Verifies the stored Groq key against the provider; emits groq_status.

operations.name: test_notification
operations.notes: Fires a one-off test notification.

operations.name: transcript_changed
operations.notes: Carries the review segments and transcript blocks for the transcript screen.

operations.name: ui_ready
operations.notes: Legacy ui_ready slot is acknowledged (noop); readiness is driven by the sidecar ready event and pageReady.

operations.name: unschedule_job
operations.notes: Removes a job's schedule; emits queue_changed.

operations.name: update_available
operations.notes: Updater events are deferred.

operations.name: update_error
operations.notes: Updater events are deferred.

operations.name: update_progress
operations.notes: Updater events are deferred.

operations.name: update_ready
operations.notes: Updater events are deferred.

operations.name: update_state
operations.notes: Updater events are deferred.

operations.name: validate_cuda
operations.notes: Reports the honest CUDA (NVIDIA GPU) backend state via the registry; emits cuda_status.

operations.name: validate_vulkan
operations.notes: Reports the honest Vulkan/compute-backend state via the engine registry; emits vulkan_status.

operations.name: vulkan_status
operations.notes: Vulkan/compute-backend availability and selection report.

operations.name: whatsnew
operations.notes: Updater/whats-new events are deferred.

operations.name: whatsnew_seen
operations.notes: Updater/whats-new is deferred.

operations.name: rename_job
operations.notes: Renames a job (persisted in its manifest); refreshes jobs_changed and active_job.

operations.name: get_settings
operations.notes: Returns the full persisted settings snapshot; the UI relies on defaults when absent.

operations.name: job_queued
operations.notes: Emitted when a job enters the processing queue.

operations.name: job_started
operations.notes: Emitted when a job begins processing.

operations.name: job_failed
operations.notes: Emitted when a job fails; carries the failed stage and sanitized error.

operations.name: job_cancelled
operations.notes: Emitted when a job is cancelled.

operations.name: download_progress
operations.notes: Coalesced download progress (link import or CUDA pack).

operations.name: study_progress
operations.notes: Coalesced study generation progress (quiz/flashcards/smart-study).

operations.name: runtime_missing
operations.notes: Emitted when a required runtime component is missing.

operations.name: repair_required
operations.notes: Emitted when runtime repair is required; the frontend must confirm before any install.

operations.name: storage_warning
operations.notes: Emitted when the data dir crosses a storage warning threshold.
